verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an official MCP server and plugin/API surface (access tokens, object and property access 'to enable external rendering') and cites open output formats like SVG, CSS, HTML and JSON. None of the evidence explicitly shows an agent triggering a render or export through that surface. Probes found no published OpenAPI spec, so the programmatic export surface is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: documented MCP/API export or render tools (screenshots, PNG/PDF/SVG export), an API reference covering export, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven export.
